title: May Day labor rally/procession demanding minimum wage and union rights
location: In front of National Press Club, Dhaka
scope: One specifically identified joint rally/procession; other May Day organizations in the same report held separate actions and are not merged here.
organizer: National Workers Unity Centre and Green Bangla Garments Workers Federation
threshold_50_evidence: unknown; opened report identifies organizers and rally/procession but does not estimate attendance.

start_date.summary: Dhaka Tribune dates the May Day actions to Monday, May 1, 2023.

location.summary: Named joint rally and procession gathered in front of the National Press Club in Dhaka.

organizer.summary: National Workers Unity Centre and Green Bangla Garments Workers Federation jointly organized this rally/procession.

demands.summary: Demanded trade-union rights and Tk22,000 minimum wages for workers and employees.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The article confirms a rally/procession but gives no count or qualitative size.

protester_violence.summary: unknown; no evidence either way in this source.

state_response.summary: unknown; no event-specific response in this source.

notes: May Day reporting covers several distinct organizations and actions; do not apply one attendance estimate across them. The named rally demands state labor policy changes, but threshold remains unverified. Other group actions are retained for follow-up/source review.
open_questions: Can this specific joint rally be shown to have at least 50 attendees?
Can reporting distinguish the other May Day actions and their attendance without syndication?

location.summary: Dhaka actions; specific location not given for every organization.

participants.summary: No size given for these actions.

title: BNP march demanding government resignation in Dhaka
location: From near Bangladesh Medical College in Shankar/Dhanmondi to Science Laboratory, Dhaka
scope: Single Dhaka Metropolitan South BNP protest march followed by a disputed clash after the march ended.
threshold_50_evidence: unknown; article reports a march, several people injured and 15 people detained but no total participant count.

start_date.summary: bdnews24 reports the action on Tuesday afternoon, May 23, 2023.

location.summary: Started near Bangladesh Medical College in Shankar at 4 pm and ended near Lab Aid Hospital in Science Laboratory.

organizer.summary: Organized by Dhaka Metropolitan South BNP.

demands.summary: March demanded resignation of Awami League government and protested arrest/harassment of BNP leaders; after clashes BNP demanded release of detained leaders and condemned injuries.

participants.summary: No total count; 15 detainees are not total participants.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendance estimate; injuries and detentions cannot stand in for size.

protester_violence.summary: unknown because reports conflict: BNP said police attacked them; police alleged BNP activists attacked officers. Article reports a bus was vandalized/burned but attribution is disputed.

state_response.summary: Police detained leaders (15 total per officer) and used tear gas to disperse crowd; BNP and police disagree about clash initiation.

notes: The source distinguishes the march from the clash that began shortly after organizers said the march ended. State action is coded only for reported detentions and tear gas; conflicting accounts do not support a finding of protester violence. Threshold remains unknown.
open_questions: Can a participant estimate establish >=50 in the march?
Did the march end before the reported clash, and should the later confrontation be kept as a separate action?
